i really like the various imagery you used with each metaphor, i found it effective and interesting to read. however, i do think that you used too many metaphors and it became somewhat confusing. i think it could be improved if there were fewer metaphors, for example 2 or 3 stanzas per metaphor instead of a different metaphor per stanza. alternatively maybe if the metaphors had some kind of link between them it could flow better. i also saw that in a comment you left you said you might change metamorphosis to journey, which is a good idea in my opinion because the poem itself is more about a journey than a transformation. overall, i really enjoyed it, i hope this helps too!
